skill.name: agent-tools
skill.description: Guides agents in using the inference.sh CLI to discover and run cloud AI apps for media generation, LLM calls, search, 3D assets, and Twitter/X automation.
skill.summary: Use inference.sh CLI commands to discover apps, generate inputs, run tasks, and check cloud results.
skill.author: inference-sh-7

security_audit.summary: Confirmed risks are concentrated in remote installer guidance that pipes downloaded content into a shell and uses dynamic command substitution. Most hardcoded URL, environment variable, filesystem, and Markdown backtick findings are documentation or legitimate CLI references. A semantic concern remains because the skill can guide public Twitter/X actions through the infsh CLI.

remediation.issue: Remote installer examples use curl piped directly to sh.
remediation.suggestion: Replace pipe-to-shell instructions with a download, checksum verification, signature verification, and explicit execution step.

remediation.issue: Manual install instructions select a binary URL through shell command substitution from a remote manifest.
remediation.suggestion: Publish explicit per-platform download commands or a signed manifest parser that validates the selected artifact before download.

remediation.issue: Twitter/X automation examples can publish public account actions.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before any social posting, liking, retweeting, following, or direct messaging command.

content.user_title: Run Cloud AI Apps from Your Agent
content.value_statement: Teams need one workflow for many hosted AI models and media tools. This skill gives agents structured inference.sh CLI guidance for discovery, execution, and result tracking.
actual_capabilities: Guide inference.sh CLI installation, login, and authentication checks.
List, search, filter, and inspect available inference.sh apps.
Generate sample input files before running an app.
Run image, video, audio, text, search, 3D, and utility apps.
Track long-running tasks and retrieve saved results.
Use examples for FLUX, Veo, OpenRouter, Tavily, Exa, and X automation.
limitations: It requires the infsh CLI and an authenticated inference.sh account.
It can run only apps available through the inference.sh platform.
Some apps may incur usage costs or expose submitted prompts to third-party providers.
Twitter/X automation can publish account actions and should require explicit confirmation.

use_cases.title: Prototype AI Features
use_cases.description: Find hosted models, inspect schemas, generate sample inputs, and run trial jobs without building separate integrations.

use_cases.title: Generate Media Assets
use_cases.description: Run image, video, audio, and 3D generation apps from a consistent command workflow.

use_cases.title: Run Search and LLM Tasks
use_cases.description: Use search and LLM apps for research, summarization, answer generation, and task tracking.

prompt_templates.title: Find an App
prompt_templates.prompt: Use agent-tools to search inference.sh for [task]. Compare relevant apps and recommend one option.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Simple Job
prompt_templates.prompt: Use agent-tools to generate a sample input for [app]. Explain required fields and run it after I approve.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Media Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use agent-tools to create a workflow that generates [asset], tracks the task, and saves the result.

prompt_templates.title: Operate a Multi-App Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Use agent-tools to discover, validate, and run inference.sh apps for [pipeline]. Include cost, privacy, and confirmation checkpoints.

output_examples.input: Find an image generation app for product mockups.
output: A ranked shortlist of image apps.
One recommended app with why it fits.
Setup notes and approval checkpoints before execution.

output_examples.input: Generate a short video from a prompt and track the task.
output: A selected video app and required input plan.
A confirmation request before running the job.
Task tracking guidance and result retrieval steps.

output_examples.input: Use web search to gather current information about a topic.
output: A query plan for the requested topic.
A concise result summary with source handling notes.

best_practices: Confirm account, cost, and data sensitivity before running cloud apps.
Generate and review sample inputs before submitting a production task.
Require explicit approval before social media or other account-changing actions.
anti_patterns: Do not run installer commands without verifying the downloaded artifact.
Do not submit secrets, private data, or regulated content as model input without approval.
Do not automate Twitter/X actions without a clear user request and confirmation.

faq.question: What does this skill help an agent do?
faq.answer: It helps an agent use the inference.sh CLI to discover apps, prepare inputs, run tasks, and retrieve results.

faq.question: Does it require an inference.sh account?
faq.answer: Yes. The CLI must be installed and authenticated before most commands can run.

faq.question: Can it generate images and videos?
faq.answer: Yes. The references include image, video, audio, text, search, 3D, and utility app workflows.

faq.question: Can it call Claude or OpenRouter models?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes examples for Claude through OpenRouter and other LLM app providers.

faq.question: Can it post to Twitter/X?
faq.answer: Yes, if the connected inference.sh app and account allow it. Users should confirm every public action first.

faq.question: What are the main safety concerns?
faq.answer: Installer commands, cloud data submission, usage costs, and account-changing automation need review before execution.
